purpose: Find real original archive radio observations that actually cover frozen SPEAR directions, with telescope-frequency-dependent beam admission, raw-byte integrity, real pointing and independent ON/OFF. Only then consider unchanged JANUS native detector; no score or discovery claims from listing alone.
target_date_2026_11_21_semantics: target positions fixed in original R1; geometry derived positions are exploratory, not independent objects

public_archive_search.selection: Archive coordinates/filename matched using haversine 3D angular separation; correct RA wrap. Include all catalog listings, not just nearest.

beam_preflight.GBT: Gregorian FWHM ≈ 12.60 / freq_GHz arcmin (GBO site); half-power radial threshold FWHM/2. Prime focus ~13.01 / freq_GHz if receiver proven; otherwise use Gregorian for conservative screening.
beam_preflight.Parkes: Conservative UWL/Multibeam APPROX FWHM 12 arcmin*(1.4GHz/frequency_GHz); receiver dependent, not an observation claim; Parkes multi-beam 14.3 arcmin at 1.42 GHz, UWL ~12 arcmin at 1.4 GHz. No confirmed per-feed offset beam or pointing.
beam_preflight.frequency: Archive center frequency is not a verified native spectral band; rank by center only; require original HDF5/filterbank header and receiver for physically valid coverage.
beam_preflight.science_gate: Catalog source coordinates are not measured encoder pointing. A center-frequency half-power match only makes a raw-data acquisition candidate, not a verified on-sky radio spectrum of OSIRIS.

deterministic_priority: exact original ≤0.5*FWHM archive-center original HDF5, file byte-size≤350MB with valid archive MD5 and ON/OFF same epoch
same with bytes≤1.5GB read-only metadata control
catalog off-beam candidates are NOT a substitute for pointing
group_selection.independent_control: At least one matched instrument sky negative and independent pointing; null-control RA rotations are search-footprint controls only, not matched radio-noise examples.
